endings.name: Dawn Above
lines: The last door opens onto grey morning.
Behind you the Hollow settles, and is quiet.

endings.name: The Last Door
lines: The Hollow One falls, and every candle in the deep goes out at once.
Its first breath and its last were the same breath.
You climb toward a light that does not flicker.

endings.name: Unwritten
lines: The Unformed comes apart like wet paper.
Where it stood there is nothing, not even a shadow.
Somewhere above, a story you were never told begins to write itself.

endings.name: Untouched
lines: Not a scratch. The Hollow does not know what to make of you.
It lets you go, the way a river lets go of a stone.

endings.name: Made Whole
lines: Piece by piece you took back what the Hollow kept.
At the surface, for the first time, you cast a shadow.

endings.name: Saint's Rest
lines: The Saint lays down the lantern of their faith.
The dark below was never punishment. It was only dark.

endings.name: Through the Nightmare
lines: Every horror the Hollow could make, it made for you.

endings.name: Trial's End
lines: The rules were cruel. You kept them anyway.
The Hollow marks your name in its ledger of trials.

achievements.name: Not Enough
achievements.description: See the Through the Nightmare ending.
